name: Netlify MCP Server
summary: Netlify's official MCP server: lets code agents create, deploy and manage Netlify projects, env vars, forms, extensions and access controls via the Netlify API and CLI.
description: Netlify recommends the remote server at `https://netlify-mcp.netlify.app/mcp` (set up with `npx -y add-mcp https://netlify-mcp.netlify.app/mcp`); the local server runs with `npx -y @netlify/mcp` (Node.js 22+). Netlify also publishes agent skills for Functions, Edge Functions, Blobs, Database, deploys and more (`npx skills add netlify/context-and-tools`). Requires a Netlify account.
